description: Agent-based, network-mediated diffusion of mask adoption under social influence, household norms, policy mandates/enforcement, media messaging, and market availability. Agents decide daily whether to wear masks in different locations, purchase masks subject to supply, and update beliefs from peers, media, and policy.

parameters.ideology_distribution: polarized centered at 0 with variance controlled by ideology_polarization

parameters.norm_strength_distribution: truncated normal with household_norm_strength_mean and sd

parameters.rationing_policy: limit per purchase if supply_rationing true

modules.name: InitializationModule
modules.description: Constructs agents, households, locations, retailers, social network; assigns attributes and initial states.

update_rule.pseudocode:
1. Set RNG with random_seed
2. Create N=population_size Person agents; assign age, income ~ LogNormal(income_log_mean, income_log_sd), demographic_group ~ categorical(demographic_group_count), ideology ~ Normal(0, ideology_polarization), trust_in_authorities ~ TruncNormal(trust_in_authorities_mean, sd), compliance_sensitivity ~ TruncNormal(compliance_sensitivity_mean, sd), perceived_cost ~ TruncNormal(perceived_cost_mean, sd), media_exposure_level ~ TruncNormal(media_exposure_level_mean, sd), risk_perception = risk_perception_base
3. Assign households: sample sizes via zero-truncated geometric with household_geom_p within [household_size_min, household_size_max]; create households with norm_strength ~ TruncNormal(mean, sd); distribute agents into households; set household.mask_supply ~ Poisson(size*2)
4. Create workplaces, schools, retail, transit, public_space locations per counts; set capacity and contact_rate per type
5. Create retailers (retailer_count) with inventory=initial_inventory_per_retailer and price=mask_unit_cost
6. Initialize policy with mandates off and parameters set
7. Initialize media channels count=media_channel_count with reach≈media_reach, frequency≈media_broadcasts_per_day, bias ~ Normal(media_message_bias_mean, media_message_bias_sd), misinformation_rate=media_misinformation_rate
8. Build social network with SocialNetworkModule parameters
9. Set initial mask_adoption_state for a fraction initial_adoption_rate of agents (random), set habit_strength = mask_adoption_state * 0.5, adherence_level = mask_adoption_state
10. Initialize time t=0
notes: TruncNormal clamps values to [0,1] where applicable
Household income_band derived from household members' incomes

modules.name: SocialNetworkModule
modules.description: Constructs and manages the social network; computes descriptive norms and social influence signals.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t==0 and state.network not built: build Watts-Strogatz graph with avg_degree, rewiring_prob; else if is_network_dynamic: with small prob, rewire edges
For each person i: compute neighbor masking m_i = mean(mask_adoption_state of neighbors)
Update memory_of_peer_masking_i = memory_of_peer_masking_i * exp(-ln(2)/descriptive_norm_memory_halflife_days) + m_i * (1 - exp(-ln(2)/descriptive_norm_memory_halflife_days))
Set signals.peer_masking_fraction[i] = m_i
Compute signals.social_norm[i] = 0.7*m_i + 0.3*location_observed_masking[i] (if provided else 0.7*m_i)
notes: Uses exponential decay to maintain memory of peer masking
Combines network and public location observations

modules.name: HouseholdModule
modules.description: Implements within-household influence and shared mask supply.

update_rule.pseudocode:
For each household h: compute household_masking = mean(mask_adoption_state of members)
For each member i in h: signals.household_norm_influence[i] = within_household_influence_weight * h.norm_strength * (household_masking - 0.5)
notes: Positive if household masking above 50%, negative otherwise
Mask supply is decremented when members purchase/use masks

modules.name: PolicyModule
modules.description: Schedules and enforces policy mandates, enforcement levels, fines, and campaign intensity.

notes: Messaging strategy is fixed and used by MediaModule

modules.name: MediaModule
modules.description: Broadcasts media and policy campaign messages; updates agent risk perception and trust via exposure with bias and misinformation.

update_rule.pseudocode:
For each channel c: draw broadcasts ~ Poisson(media_broadcasts_per_day); construct message valence v_c = campaign_intensity * (1 - c.misinformation_rate) + c.message_bias
For each person i: exposure_prob = i.media_exposure_level * c.reach; if Bernoulli(exposure_prob): accumulate media_signal_i += v_c; misinfo adds negative component proportional to media_misinformation_rate and (1 - trust_in_authorities_i) * misinfo_exposure_bias
Normalize media_signal_i to [-1,1]
Update risk_perception_i = clamp(risk_perception_i + risk_perception_growth_rate * max(0, media_signal_i), 0, 1)
Set signals.media_influence[i] = media_signal_i; signals.updated_risk_perception[i] = risk_perception_i
notes: Risk perception only increases with pro-risk messages; misinformation can reduce media_influence and slow growth
Message bias accounts for channel slant

modules.name: MarketModule
modules.description: Simulates mask retail supply, pricing, and purchases by households.

update_rule.pseudocode:
Demand estimation: For each household h, desired_qty_h = sum_over_members( indicator(member intends to adopt today) ) - h.mask_supply; desired_qty_h = max(0, desired_qty_h)
Allocate households to retailers uniformly or nearest; For each retailer r: available=r.inventory_level; ration_limit = rationing_limit_per_purchase if supply_rationing else inf
For each assigned household in random order: purchase = min(desired_qty_h, available, ration_limit); r.inventory_level -= purchase; h.mask_supply += purchase; record purchase
Price update: For each retailer r: excess_demand = (yesterday_demand - yesterday_supply)/max(1, yesterday_supply); r.price = clamp(r.price * (1 + price_adjustment_sensitivity * excess_demand), price_floor, price_ceiling)
Restock: r.inventory_level += max(0, round(Normal(restock_rate_per_day * initial_inventory_per_retailer, restock_variability_sd * initial_inventory_per_retailer)))
Outputs: mask_availability = mean(r.inventory_level > 0); price_mean = mean(r.price); stockout_today = share of retailers with inventory_level == 0
notes: Demand is induced by DecisionModule intent; intent provided via previous day or pre-decision signal
Stockout penalty applied in DecisionModule via signals.mask_availability

modules.name: MobilityAndLocationModule
modules.description: Generates daily movement schedule, observes public masking, and enforces location policies with fines/compliance.

update_rule.pseudocode:
For each person i: construct itinerary per daily_location_schedule (work/school if applicable, retail/public, transit as needed)
At each visited location L: compute local_masking_prev = mean(current mask wearing among present agents from previous step or rolling)
If mask policy active at L: compliance_prob = compliance_baseline + adherence_level_i * 0.3 + trust_in_authorities_i * 0.2 - perceived_cost_i * 0.2 + enforcement_level * 0.2 + Normal(0, compliance_shock_std)
If non-compliant (Bernoulli(1 - compliance_prob)) and Bernoulli(enforcement_level): issue fine of fine_amount; record in cumulative_fines and reduce future compliance via enforcement_effectiveness_decay and update fine memory with halflife fine_memory_halflife_days
Update signals.location_observed_masking[i] = running average of local_masking_prev weighted by contact_rate of L
Aggregate compliance_feedback (rate of compliance in mandated locations)
notes: contact_rate by location type weights observations
Fines and enforcement adjust future compliance through feedback

requirements: Location capacity assignment and admission control

modules.name: DecisionModule
modules.description: Computes daily mask adoption propensity and adherence decisions using a logistic model and habit dynamics.

update_rule.pseudocode:
For each person i:
  social_signal = signals.social_norm[i]
  policy_signal = signals.enforcement_level * mean(policy_presence relevant to i's itinerary)
  media_signal = signals.media_influence[i]
  risk_signal = signals.updated_risk_perception[i]
  availability_penalty = (signals.mask_availability < 0.5) ? stockout_penalty_on_adoption : 0
  linear = logit_intercept + logit_social_coeff*social_signal + logit_policy_coeff*policy_signal + logit_media_coeff*media_signal + logit_risk_coeff*risk_signal - perceived_cost_i + household_norm_influence[i]
  propensity = sigmoid(linear)
  propensity = propensity * (1 - availability_penalty)
  propensity = influence_weight_social*social_signal + influence_weight_policy*policy_signal + influence_weight_media*media_signal + influence_weight_personal_risk*risk_signal + 0.2*habit_strength_i - perceived_cost_i
  propensity = clamp(propensity, 0, 1)
  intent_to_adopt = (propensity >= adoption_threshold)
  Update habit_strength_i = (1 - habit_decay)*habit_strength_i + 0.5*intent_to_adopt
  Update mask_adoption_state_i = intent_to_adopt
Emit signals.intent_to_adopt; write back updated adoption state
notes: Combines logistic and weighted-sum propensity with clamping for robustness
Habit reinforces recent adoption; decays otherwise

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily observables and prepares metrics.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate = mean(mask_adoption_state over all persons)
compliance_rate = signals.compliance_feedback (already aggregated)
stockout_rate = signals.stockout_today
price_mean = signals.price_mean
adoption_by_group = groupby(demographic_group).mean(mask_adoption_state)
Compute cascade sizes: identify nodes that switched from 0->1 today; for each, run BFS over neighbors that switch within a short window (1 day) and attribute to seed if first exposure; accumulate distribution
Compute gini_adoption across groups using group means
cumulative_fines = running sum of fines to date
Emit observables
notes: Cascade approximation attributes same-day switches to immediate neighbors
Gini computed on group-level adoption means

parameters.description: Number of demographic groups to assign.
Std dev of ideology orientation distribution.
Mean perceived cost of mask wearing.
Mean baseline media exposure of agents.
Target clustering; used to choose small-world parameters.
Half-life for memory of peer masking.
Parameter for geometric household size distribution.
Probability of enforcement action when non-compliant.
Upper bound on fines when adjusted.
Share of misinformation in media content.
Average broadcasts per channel per day.
Daily increase to risk perception from positive media.
Bias that increases misinformation impact for low-trust agents.
Fraction of initial stock restocked daily.
If true, limit masks per purchase.
Max units sold per household per day under rationing.
Unit production/base cost used for initial price.
Elasticity of demand w.r.t price affecting intent translation to purchases.
Penalty multiplier applied to propensity when masks are unavailable.
Base compliance probability in mandated settings.
Daily decay in the effect of past enforcement on compliance.
Half-life for memory of being fined.
Number of retail locations (distinct from retailers if desired).
Weight for social influence in weighted-sum propensity.

observables.formula_or_field: size distribution of same-day 0->1 cascades on network
Gini coefficient across group-level adoption means

algorithms.WattsStrogatz: Generate small-world social network with N nodes, K ≈ avg_degree, rewiring probability rewiring_prob.
algorithms.LogisticDecision: Compute logistic propensity with coefficients, then combine with weighted signals and habit, threshold to decide adoption.
algorithms.InventoryPricing: Price adjusts multiplicatively by sensitivity * excess demand; restock via noisy replenishment.
algorithms.PolicyEnforcement: Compliance probability function with enforcement and fines; stochastic fine issuance.
algorithms.CascadeAttribution: Approximate cascade sizes using same-day neighbor-trigger BFS over edges.
